episodes.title: Surviving Zendik Farm
episodes.description: Told through archival footage and intimate interviews, this documentary explores the Zendik Farm, a commune that promised an alternative to mainstream society. Former members reflect on the community's charismatic leaders, radical sexual practices, and child rearing experiments. They share stories of trauma, manipulation, and liberation, recounting their difficult journeys of rebuilding their lives in the world they were taught to despise.
